entries.question: which exam is necessary for admission
entries.answer:
For admission to Paramedical courses at KGMU, you are required to appear for the **KGMU Paramedical Entrance Examination**, which is conducted annually by the university.

**Important points to note:**

*   **University-Specific Exam:** Unlike MBBS (which requires NEET-UG), KGMU conducts its own entrance test for most of its undergraduate paramedical and nursing programs.
*   **Notification:** You must monitor the [KGMU Notice Board](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php) and the [Admissions Page](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php) for the official information brochure for the upcoming session. This brochure will contain the syllabus, exam pattern, and application dates.
*   **Eligibility:** Typically, candidates must have passed 10+2 (Intermediate) with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB) from a recognized board. Please verify the specific subject and percentage requirements in the official notification when it is released for the 2026 session.

entries.question: OPD kaise book kar sakte hain

entries.question: If I don't have refrel letter
